title: Thymus serpyllum essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Thymus serpyllum essential oil is a potent distillation of the flowering plant commonly known as wild thyme. It is extracted through steam distillation from the leaves and flowers of the plant, which is native to Europe and parts of Asia. In herbalism, this essential oil is valued for its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties. It is often used to support respiratory health, alleviate coughs, and treat skin infections. Additionally, it may be used in aromatherapy to promote mental clarity and reduce stress.
